description: List Swiss Parliament reference entries and source coverage. Choose identifiers, coverage, or languages for server explanations; statuses for the official legacy/current status snapshot; or business_types, councils, cantons, parties, groups, committees, or sessions for live dictionaries. Date filters apply only to sessions. Follow nextOffset with the same topic, language, and dates; labels remain in the requested metadata language and missing labels stay unknown.

dateFrom.description: Sessions only: inclusive StartDate lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

dateTo.description: Sessions only: inclusive EndDate upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Metadata label language: de (default), fr, or it.

limit.description: Requested page size, default 50; values above 100 are clamped with a notice. Whole-item byte fitting may return fewer entries.

offset.description: Starting row offset, default zero. Use the returned nextOffset to continue.

topic.description: Reference dictionary or explanatory topic to list.

name: chparl_list_reference

effectiveFilters.description: Normalized reference filters and resolved paging defaults.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive session StartDate lower bound, if supplied.

dateTo.description: Inclusive session EndDate upper bound, if supplied.

limit.description: Effective maximum entries requested from the source, capped at 100.

offset.description: Requested starting row, before any whole-item response-size fitting.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective row limit after clamping; response-size fitting may deliver fewer.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_fields`: Session dates were supplied for another topic, or dateFrom is after dateTo. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: Whether entries remain beyond this delivered page.

items.description: Complete reference entries delivered on this page.
One source reference record or explicitly identified server explanation.

abbreviation.description: Published abbreviation, including an existing empty string.

active.description: Published active flag; absent does not imply false.

code.description: Published status or parliamentary-group code when available.

councilId.description: Published numeric council key, resolved with topic councils.

description.description: Source description, session number and type, or explicit server explanation.

endDate.description: Published end date normalized from OData DateTime without an invented timezone.

era.description: Status vocabulary before or from 1 July 2023.

id.description: Source dictionary key, or stable identifier for a server explanation.

label.description: Original source label in the requested language; omitted when unpublished. Static facts use server explanations.

legislativePeriod.description: Published legislative period number for a session.

startDate.description: Published start date normalized from OData DateTime without an invented timezone.

nextOffset.description: Original offset plus delivered entries; absent when exhausted.

notice.description: Combined limit, whole-item byte-budget, empty-result, or past-end guidance.

provenance.description: Attribution, publication status, and source download dates.

officialPublication.description: This server is an unofficial reproduction of the source.

sources.description: Every HTTP response contributing data, or each static source snapshot.

items.description: A source used to produce this result.

retrievedAt.description: Actual UTC download timestamp, or the date of a static source snapshot.

url.description: HTTPS source response or official snapshot document URL.

returnedCount.description: Number of complete entries actually delivered.

totalCount.description: Whole-query reference count when the source supplies one.

title: Chparl List Reference
